messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Tutorial - Problems building Application
parts:
Hi Andrew,

Sorry for the jargon. "~/" is shorthand for your home directory, on R for Windows I believe it defaults to your My Documents directory.

The |-- is just trying to be a graphical representation that those two files are under the directory shown above. In other words,

My Documents\shinyapp\ui.R
My Documents\shinyapp\server.R

Hope that helps.

messages.subject: Re: Tutorial - Problems building Application
parts:
The problem is with this part:
  url('http://www.systematicportfolio.com/sit.gz', 'rb')

That URL gets a 302 redirect to another URL. It appears that on Mac and Linux, the url() function apparently gives an error when it encounters a redirect, but on Windows, it will successfully follow a redirect.

I would suggest downloading the sit.gz file yourself, unzipping it, and saving in the same directory as your Shiny app. Then you can source the file in your app. This will avoid the error, and it will also be more efficient - there's no need to download the file each time your app is used.

-Winston
